message.content:
The three most significant schisms in Christian history are:

| # | Schism | Approximate Year | Key Parties | Main Issue |
|---|--------|------------------|-------------|------------|
| 1 | **Great Schism (East‑West Schism)** | 1054 | Eastern Orthodox Churches vs. Roman Catholic Church | Doctrinal differences (e.g., Filioque clause, papal primacy) and cultural/administrative disputes |
| 2 | **Protestant Reformation** | 1517–1648 | Various European reformers (Luther, Calvin, Zwingli, etc.) vs. Roman Catholic Church | Authority of Scripture, justification by faith, church practices, and governance |
| 3 | **East‑West Schism (Second Great Schism)** | 1965 | Eastern Orthodox Churches vs. Roman Catholic Church | Reconciliation attempts, theological dialogue, and mutual recognition |

These events reshaped the religious, political, and cultural landscape of Europe and beyond.
